title: Illustration / Characters / Mouths / No boundaries
slide_intent: Let expression exceed the facial outline while preserving internal alignment so an extreme emotion remains legible.
strategic_value: A controlled exception to the head boundary can help Duolingo exaggerate emotion without making the mouth construction arbitrary.
demonstration: Two accepted faces show mouths extending to or beyond the facial outline; a third face is crossed out, and the text distinguishes external freedom from centered internal details.
practical_value: Allow a mouth to break the face frame for stronger emotion, then center its teeth and tongue within the mouth.

content_islands.name: Boundary examples
content_islands.spec: Place two accepted exaggerated mouths at left and a rejected example in a crossed frame beside them.

content_islands.name: Internal alignment condition
content_islands.spec: Set the No Boundaries heading and two short statements at right, pairing the allowed extension with the centering requirement.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source permits breaking the face frame to convey more extreme emotions.
reference_purposes.Application: The comparison demonstrates exaggerated mouth placement.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Teeth and tongue must remain centered within the mouth.

ingredient.name: Mouth boundary exception
ingredient.role: Amplify emotion while keeping the mouth understandable.
ingredient.application: The mouth may extend outside the face frame for extreme expression; always center the teeth and tongue inside the mouth.
ingredient.scope: Historical official Duolingo illustration guidance from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot. The permission concerns the mouth’s relationship to the face; it does not relax the stated internal alignment rule.
